issues.description: The package supplies the identifier/date workbook and two R programs, not the author-described full master, coded report/response inputs, or the named analysis workbooks. Bounded current metadata confirms some local Compustat, CRSP, short-interest, and Audit Analytics components, but not the author joins, full histories, sample population, or master-producing program. No provider access barrier is established.

Both entrypoints source the absent my_favorite_shared_functions.R file. Custom functions include EnsurePackage and fread.zip; winsorize is also called. Their implementation and I/O contracts are unavailable. Do not run the helper because EnsurePackage may install packages.
Figure and table entrypoints use pathbase to form data and shared-helper paths; the table entrypoint shows a commented pathbase assignment. Configure a coherent project root before running.
The table entrypoint changes the working directory through workdir; configure that directory for the target host and align it with the project root and input layout.

The figure entrypoint contains a literal backslash followed by a space in an ordinary R workbook-path string. R documentation states that an escape outside the recognized table is an error; no parser or author-program trial was performed.

At table lines 3648–3649 stargazer is passed selection6_table5a and probit_mfx_selection6_table5a. The immediately preceding assignments define selection6_table5 and probit_mfx_selection6_table5; the suffixed names do not occur elsewhere in the supplied file.

The monthly figure source reads and date-parses crsp_monthly_matched_1994-2019.txt, but its required downstream role is not established in the supplied workflow; retain the input requirement pending clarification.

evidence.quote:
# original
master <- data.table(read_excel(paste(data.dir,"/Core\ data/Master_Report_File/Master_Report_Data_Core_V08.xlsx",sep=""),3))
outcomes <- data.table(read_excel(paste(data.dir,"/Responses/press_releases/press_releases_coded_V05.xlsx",sep=""),1))
# if we take this file, we get gvkey, cusips, permno, etc .

file <- file[, c("event_id","event_date.x","act_ticker","matchpermno","matchgvkey","activist_id","act_cik"),with=F]
setnames(file,c("event_id","event_date","ticker","permno","gvkey","activist_id","cik"))
file[,event_date:=as.Date(as.character(event_date))]

#DAILY
# media
media_file <- data.table(read_excel(paste(data.dir,"/Factset/factset_mediacount_events.xlsx",sep=""),1))
media_file[,date:=ymd(date)]

# short interest 
shortint_file <- fread.zip(paste(data.dir,"/short_interest_1995-2019.zip",sep=""))
shortint_file[, datadate :=  as.Date(as.character(datadate),format="%Y%m%d")]

# crsp_daily
crsp_daily <- fread.zip(paste(data.dir,"/crsp_daily_1994-2019.zip",sep=""))

evidence.description: Figure source constructs the daily window, joins media/short-interest/CRSP, and adds dated response indicators.
evidence.quote:
# could be media on holidays and weekends, move dates forward to the next business day, then sum by business day
media_file[,date := adjust("UnitedStates/NYSE",date)] # roll non business days forward to next business day
media_file <- media_file[,.(mediacount = sum(mediacount)),by=.(event_id,date)] # sum to get media count for each firm business day, including articles from preceding non-business days


## GENERATE PANEL
start <- -90 # days prior to event
end <- 90 # days after event
n <- nrow(file) # number of events in panel
panel_daily <- file[rep(seq_len(n), (end-start)+1), ] # make copies of the data frame for each day from start to end
panel_daily$eventtime <- rep((start):(end),each=n) # set "eventtime" field to be the number of periods relative to day 0
setkeyv(panel_daily,c("event_id","eventtime")) # reorder by event_id then eventtime
# make sure each event-time row has a proper date (business day if daily for example)
# need to group by eventtime because advance function can't take a vector of steps as input
panel_daily[,date:=advance("UnitedStates/NYSE",event_date,eventtime,0),by=eventtime]  

# now copy on matching data to event-day 
# media
panel_daily <- media_file[panel_daily,on=c("event_id","date")]
# set to zero when mediacount variable is NA
panel_daily[is.na(mediacount),mediacount:=0] 

# calculate abnormal media pct in days -65 to -20 (make sure to have -63 to capture a full quarter so EA is included)
panel_daily[eventtime %in% c(-65:-20),normmedia := mean(mediacount),by=event_id] # mean for measurment days
panel_daily[,normmedia := max(normmedia,na.rm=T),by=event_id] # fill in for norm value for days excluded in initial calculation
panel_daily[,abmedia := winsorize(100 * (mediacount/normmedia - 1))]
panel_daily[is.infinite(abmedia),abmedia:=100]
panel_daily[is.nan(abmedia),abmedia:=0]
summary(panel_daily)

# short interest
setorder(shortint_file,gvkey,datadate)
shortint_file[,matchdate := datadate] # date match field
panel_daily[,matchdate := date]

panel_daily <- shortint_file[,.(gvkey,matchdate,shortdate=datadate,shortint)][panel_daily,on=c("gvkey","matchdate"),roll="nearest",mult="first"]

# crsp, including shares outstanding
setorder(crsp_daily,PERMNO,date)
setorder(panel_daily,event_id,date)

panel_daily <- crsp_daily[,.(permno=PERMNO,date,SHROUT,RET,DLSTCD,DLRET,VOL,BID,ASK,vwretd,ewretd,sprtrn)][
  panel_daily,on=c("permno","date"),mult="first"]

panel_daily[,shortpct := winsorize(shortint / (SHROUT * 1000))]
panel_daily[is.na(shortpct),shortpct:=0]


# responses
summary(outcomes)
panel_daily <- outcomes[!is.na(pr_date),.(event_id,date=as.Date(pr_date),discpr=1)][panel_daily,on=c("event_id","date"),mult="first"]
panel_daily[is.na(discpr),discpr:=0]
panel_daily <- outcomes[!is.na(`8k_date`),.(event_id,date=as.Date(`8k_date`),disc8k=1)][panel_daily,on=c("event_id","date"),mult="first"]
panel_daily[is.na(disc8k),disc8k:=0]
panel_daily <- outcomes[!is.na(conference_call_date),.(event_id,date=as.Date(conference_call_date),disccc=1)][panel_daily,on=c("event_id","date"),mult="first"]
panel_daily[is.na(disccc),disccc:=0]
